locator: Computing and the Internet; Inventions; Astronomy and spaceflight

variants.en: macOS is completely immune to all malware.
variants.zh: macOS完全免疫于所有恶意软件。

correction.en: Malware targeting macOS exists; no such universal immunity is present.
correction.zh: 针对macOS的恶意软件存在，并没有这种普遍免疫。

variants.en: Linux systems cannot be infected by any malware.
variants.zh: Linux系统不可能感染任何恶意软件。

correction.en: Linux-targeted malware exists; operating-system choice does not guarantee immunity.
correction.zh: 针对Linux的恶意软件存在；操作系统选择不保证免疫。

variants.en: Incognito mode hides all browsing activity from the internet provider.
variants.zh: 无痕模式会向互联网提供商隐藏所有浏览活动。

correction.en: Incognito limits local browser records, not network-provider visibility.
correction.zh: 无痕模式限制本地浏览器记录，不隐藏网络提供商的观察。

variants.en: Websites cannot identify or track any visitor using Incognito mode.
variants.zh: 网站无法识别或跟踪任何使用无痕模式的访客。

correction.en: Websites may still observe IP addresses, account logins, and other identifying signals.
correction.zh: 网站仍可观察IP地址、账户登录和其他识别信号。

variants.en: Closing all Incognito windows automatically deletes every bookmark saved in them.
variants.zh: 关闭所有无痕窗口会自动删除其中保存的所有书签。

correction.en: Bookmarks saved during Incognito sessions remain after the windows close.
correction.zh: 无痕会话中保存的书签在窗口关闭后仍保留。

variants.en: Downloaded files disappear from disk as soon as an Incognito session ends.
variants.zh: 无痕会话结束时下载文件会立即从磁盘消失。

correction.en: Downloaded files remain on the device until separately deleted.
correction.zh: 下载文件会保留在设备上，直到被另行删除。

variants.en: James Watt invented the first steam engine ever built.
variants.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特发明了最早的蒸汽机。

correction.en: Watt improved earlier steam engines, including Newcomen's design.
correction.zh: 瓦特改进了早期蒸汽机，包括纽科门的设计。

variants.en: Tang drink powder was invented by NASA for astronauts.
variants.zh: Tang饮料粉是NASA为宇航员发明的。

correction.en: Tang was developed commercially before its use on space missions.
correction.zh: Tang在用于太空任务前已经作为商业产品开发。
